signed_rows.behavior: nats-results.txt, written by nats.sh, holds the JetStream messages from the filer, including an ov-sync a.md create and a.md delete
signed_rows.fails_when: the results file is missing, or holds no message naming a.md, or fewer than two such messages

signed_rows.behavior: webhook-results.txt holds three labelled variants: default args delivers ov-sync events with the bearer header; production args with an off-container listener delivers nothing and logs the dial error; production args with a same-namespace listener delivers ov-sync events with the bearer header; no variant delivers a loki event
signed_rows.fails_when: a variant label is missing, the default or same-namespace variant shows no ov-sync event or no bearer header, the off-container variant shows a delivered event or no dial error, or any variant shows a loki event

signed_rows.behavior: decide.sh keyed refuses to run without its key env var, and decide.sh rejects an unknown case
signed_rows.fails_when: decide.sh keyed with the env var unset exits 0 or sends a request, or an unknown case exits 0

signed_rows.behavior: each SeaweedFS script reruns cleanly from a clean Docker host: it writes its results file with the recorded outcomes and leaves no container or network behind
signed_rows.fails_when: a rerun by the reviewer fails, gives results that disagree with the README, or leaves a container or network running

signed_rows.behavior: the clef-via-bifrost README and results.txt record the 400 (bare-strings), 401 (no-key) and 403 model_blocked (keyed, Hermes key) outcomes, each tied to the decide.sh case that produces it
signed_rows.fails_when: an outcome is missing, or is not tied to a decide.sh case

signed_rows.behavior: the knowledge bundle stays valid with the new prototypes section, its index, log lines and summary update or ack
